decisions.old_explanation: Appendix A1.1 sends this exact catch name to the paper's own residual `Miscellaneous fishes`, which the text (p.10) spreads over the fish groups of the region it was caught in. Sea Around Us classes the pile as medium demersals, so the candidate set is the model's four demersal/benthic finfish pools rather than every fish group; apportioned over the region 2 and region 3 pools by model biomass; region 1 is the Maldives shelf, outside LME 34.
decisions.old_component_status: not recorded in authoritative Matching; prior aggregate label is retained, components are not invented
decisions.reason: A1.1 pp39–40 and source p9 leave this residual catch category unresolved biologically and redistribute it among fish groups; no measured constituent composition is supplied. Use the provider habitat/commercial category as an explicit coarse restriction, including compatible named pools as well as generic pools. Milkfish plus includes coastal catfishes, so it is also compatible with the broad demersal label. Containment and composition remain approximations; this is not a representative composition study. Use complete source-model catch proportions for the independently reviewed eligible set. Source A2.1 p46 quantities are total1978 landings+discards normalized by one common whole-study-area denominator; ratios equal ratios of caught mass. They are pooled model catch proxies, not direct taxon-specific2019landings observations (W10 does not apply). Assume pooled catchability/composition and fixed transfer across years, regions and catch bases. The prior deliberate biomass rationale (long-term geographic proxy despite available1978 catches) is retained in the old explanation; current catch-first hierarchy instead prefers the complete usable model catches. Biomass was not rejected for missing data.

decisions.reason: A1.1 pp37–41 explicitly assigns the reporting shark/ray category to both shark pools. However A1.3 p43 explicitly places sawfish Pristis perotteti in L pisc. WoRMS resolves it to P. pristis and its complete ancestry includes Batoidea, Elasmobranchii and Chondrichthyes. The provider label does not establish exclusion of sawfishes (Batoidea explicitly names them). Retain the exact two-pool reporting assignment and add both regional L pisc candidates by an inferred biological union; the enlarged set is M9 Medium, not M1 High. No distinct chimaera compartment or observed residual composition is asserted. Use complete source-model catch proportions for the independently reviewed eligible set. Source A2.1 p46 quantities are total1978 landings+discards normalized by one common whole-study-area denominator; ratios equal ratios of caught mass. They are pooled model catch proxies, not direct taxon-specific2019landings observations (W10 does not apply). Assume pooled catchability/composition and fixed transfer across years, regions and catch bases. Prior catch-composition weights describe separately identified taxa across all1950–2019 catches; they are not an observed distribution of this residual label and are replaced by the reviewed complete-source candidate proxy.

decisions.reason: A1.1 pp39–40 and source p9 leave this residual catch category unresolved biologically and redistribute it among fish groups; no measured constituent composition is supplied. Use the provider habitat/commercial category as an explicit coarse restriction, including compatible named pools as well as generic pools. Hilsa, Indian mackerel and Coastal scombrids are named coastal pelagic pools; L pisc contains pelagic barracudas/needlefishes/dolphinfish. decisions.candidate_inclusion_rationale: Retain the supported taxonomic extension from source-listed family/genus representatives in the exact model guild, with unlisted inclusion explicitly assumed. A listed genus/relative is not a same-taxon synonym of an unlisted species. Authority records establish taxonomic connection, not measured species composition or exhaustive group containment. The source guilds have qualitative size/habitat/feeding names; no numeric maximum-length convention/cutoff was recovered, so no individual-size or stage percentages are inferred.

decisions.reason: Retain the supported taxonomic extension from source-listed family/genus representatives in the exact model guild, with unlisted inclusion explicitly assumed. A listed genus/relative is not a same-taxon synonym of an unlisted species. Authority records establish taxonomic connection, not measured species composition or exhaustive group containment. The source guilds have qualitative size/habitat/feeding names; no numeric maximum-length convention/cutoff was recovered, so no individual-size or stage percentages are inferred. Use complete source-model catch proportions for the independently reviewed eligible set. Source A2.1 p46 quantities are total1978 landings+discards normalized by one common whole-study-area denominator; ratios equal ratios of caught mass. They are pooled model catch proxies, not direct taxon-specific2019landings observations (W10 does not apply). Assume pooled catchability/composition and fixed transfer across years, regions and catch bases. The prior deliberate biomass rationale (long-term geographic proxy despite available1978 catches) is retained in the old explanation; current catch-first hierarchy instead prefers the complete usable model catches. Biomass was not rejected for missing data.
